title: Not a static comparator.
p1_desc: Costs vary based on your scenario — horizon, leverage, frequency. TradeScope applies real parameters to your specific case, not generic averages.
p2_desc: All instruments are normalised to the same delta-adjusted notional exposure. You compare apples to apples, not apples to oranges.
p3_desc: Broker fee schedules are declared and kept up to date. Affiliate links are labelled explicitly. Rankings are based solely on cost efficiency.
